name: commune
lore:
# On the Rite of Communion

To cast *Commune* is to press one’s soul against the veil of the Infinite. As the incantation peaks, the Weave thins, feeling less like raw energy and more like a silver lute-string pulled taut across the heart. One experiences a sudden, heavy stillness—the "Weight of the Divine"—as if the very air has gained the gravity of a thousand years.

Visually, the world pales. Shadows lengthen into indigo pools, and motes of starlight dance within the caster’s breath, even at high noon. It is a dialogue of resonance; truth is felt in the marrow before it is understood by the mind.

Legend attributes the spell’s discovery to **Saint Elidyr the Mute**. Trapped during the Siege of Oakhaven, he broke a forty-year vow of silence to whisper a single plea to the firmament. The heavens did not crack; instead, the clouds shifted into a vast, watchful eye, granting Elidyr the three truths required to save his people. 

Take heed, traveler: the gods value brevity. Seek not to chatter, for the silver thread is brittle and the Divine gaze is piercing.
